process_specific_libcrypto_and_provider.observation: Read-only /proc/<child-pid>/maps sampling during TEST_ONLY E2E; sampling wrapper exited 1 when a short-lived child disappeared, so process evidence and test results are recorded separately

test_deployment.process_fork_restart_thread_and_shared_c: TEST_ONLY harness forks/execs Dealer, waits for its exit, starts separate A/P0/P1 processes, then restarts A for recovery. Source A uses detached per-connection threads. Actual OpenSSL DRBG sharing, thread-local state and reseed events were not instrumented.

test_signer_tls_recipient_sqlite_and_tim.signer: Test harness creates local Ed25519 issuer keys in temporary sandbox; source reads PEM private key before marker; no key material retained in repo
test_signer_tls_recipient_sqlite_and_tim.tls: Source fixes TLS 1.3 and mTLS CA/certificate/host verification; test creates temporary identities; negotiated cipher and RNG state not recorded
test_signer_tls_recipient_sqlite_and_tim.recipient_encryption: Source uses RSA-OAEP-SHA256/MGF1-SHA256 wrapping with AES-256-GCM body; test identities are temporary; concrete encryption advantage not quantified
test_signer_tls_recipient_sqlite_and_tim.sqlite: External 3.31.1 header for temporary test build; link /tmp/s64-receiver-2404/sqlite/lib/libsqlite3.so -> /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libsqlite3.so.0, runtime 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.5; WAL/FULL source setting is not power-loss durability proof
test_signer_tls_recipient_sqlite_and_tim.timeouts: Source per-frame TLS deadline and signed escrow second-deposit wait; test API failure/timeout injections separate from natural network fault
test_signer_tls_recipient_sqlite_and_tim.target_scope: Only this WSL test configuration, not an approved production deployment

target_deployment.note: The local WSL test deployment is not substituted for the target deployment. No private key, seed, token, certificate private material or raw entropy is collected.

source_observations.dealer: score_to_mask_v3_gmw.cpp:280-286 uses RAND_bytes in chunks <= 1 MiB; :874-933 allocates semantic materials and bounded Fisher-Yates; :944-1007 signs and publishes two packages then context sequentially.
source_observations.party: score_to_mask_v3_party.cpp:169 uses RAND_bytes for P0 active seeds, :444-445 for envelope AES key/nonce and :802 for P0 output refresh; EVP RSA-OAEP and TLS may use further internal randomness.
source_observations.escrow: score_to_mask_v3_escrow.cpp:249-254 uses one 32-byte RAND_bytes call for receipt/v2 when finalizing; :427-437 writes token with COMMITTED in the same SQL transaction; retries after rollback may request another token.
source_observations.tls: protocol_i_transport.cpp:211-238 configures TLS 1.3 mTLS; :245-370 wraps the connection and checks peer certificate/hostname; actual handshake cipher and deployment CA are not fixed by this source.
